criteria.detail: All 30 v2 acceptance criteria are implemented and covered by AC-named tests. The scope extension resolved the former high finding: settings/custom roles, organization overview and workspace switching are in spec/plan; no product component remains unplanned. sdrive verify returns warn with 0 missing.

Four tasks remain incomplete: T13.2 (formatter), T13.3 (README), T13.4 (dev-only dependency advisories) and T17.2 (formatter/governance verification). The P14-P16 and T17.1/T17.3/T17.4 tasks are complete.
traceability.json has 32 rows covering all 30 acceptance criteria; every row has at least one test ID and status complete. The extension rows link TEST-065-TEST-075.
30 of 30 ACs in scope, 0 withdrawn, 30 tested: 100% coverage. The test report records 30/30 AC tests passing.
.sdrive/reports/tests/test-report-authentication-onboarding-and-access-control-v2-2026-11-08.md exists, records 30/30 AC tests, and is newer than spec.md and plan.md (both 2026-11-08 10:33).

test-evidence.json exists, exitCode 0, summary.failed 0, summary.total 30 > 0, commit 0b36f0d equals HEAD. The summary records 23 passed and 7 skipped Jest tests (the skipped tests are non-AC tests filtered by -t AC-0); the same command ran 7 Vitest AC tests, and the report/raw log reconcile 30/30 AC tests.

97 files against main. All planned product components are present, and the former settings/overview/workspace scope gap is closed. Remaining unplanned files are build/tooling and test support: packages/shared/package.json, packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json, realtime/Dockerfile, realtime/eslint.config.mjs, realtime/package.json, server/Dockerfile, server/eslint.config.mjs, web/eslint.config.mjs, pnpm-lock.yaml and server/src/database/memory-prisma.ts. No commits belong to another in-flight feature; tree is clean; branch matches feature.branch.

No .only, xit, xdescribe, it.skip, describe.skip or test.skip in the v2 test files; no empty assertions. All AC-046..AC-075 test names carry their AC ID. The 7 skipped Jest tests and 6 skipped backoffice tests are non-AC tests excluded by the recorded -t filters, not unjustified skips.

TypeScript passes for server and backoffice; eslint passes. pnpm format:check exits 2 on repository-wide files (backoffice/scripts/check-token-literals.mjs, server/src/auth/auth.e2e.spec.ts, test/**/*.mjs, .sdrive/templates/*). The extension test files themselves are Prettier-clean. T13.2/T17.2 remain open.

Secrets scan clean; CON-511..CON-519 are wired. pnpm audit reports 2 critical advisories in dev-only tinypool (pre-existing, not introduced by v2) and 5 moderate dev-tool advisories; nodemailer 10.3.1 has no advisory in this audit. No independent v2 security report exists, so security is not_verified.
30/30 AC tests pass: 23 server Jest + 7 backoffice Vitest. The full repository suite was not re-run in this review; the feature's AC evidence is the basis for this criterion.

README.md and CHANGELOG.md have no diff against main. The feature adds user-visible invitation lifecycle controls, clinic settings, overview and workspace switching, so user-facing documentation is still missing. T13.3 remains open.

NFR-014..NFR-025 are covered by tests and code, including SMTP, escaping, localization/RTL, pagination, tenant scope, permission ceilings and refresh-before-reload. The v2 spec declares no performance or SEO NFR.
The review cannot clear the feature: task completion (C02), formatter (C09), documentation (C12) and security verification (C10) are not satisfied.

baseline.detail: JWT access/refresh behaviour is unchanged; invitation, settings, role and workspace routes are guarded.
RolesGuard and capability checks remain on settings, role and workspace routes.
app.use(helmet()) remains applied globally in server/src/main.ts.
The global ThrottlerGuard remains registered; the new routes inherit the limit.
The global ValidationPipe uses whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted and transform; the new DTOs are validated.
Prisma parameterises the new queries; no new raw SQL or unsafe concatenation was introduced.
React escapes rendered values and the mail templates escape every interpolation; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML was added.
The refresh token remains an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; new mutations are POST/PATCH.
.env remains git-ignored; server/.env.example documents new keys by name only.

performance.reason: The v2 spec declares no performance or SEO NFR. NFR-014..NFR-025 cover delivery, security, escaping, localization, bounded reads and tenant scope.
